create_exaone4_config: create an Exaone4Config instance with default parameters for the EXAONE-4.0-32B model
build_exaone4_model: build an Exaone4Model from an Exaone4Config instance for inference or training
configure_sliding_window: configure sliding window attention pattern using sliding_window and sliding_window_pattern parameters
read_model_config: read Exaone4Config attributes such as vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
access_parallel_plans: access base_model_tp_plan and base_model_pp_plan for tensor and pipeline parallel distributed inference setup
